subject: Hosted API Pricing - token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@finvelocity.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing - quick follow-up + numbers

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps on the pricing side so we can put together an accurate proposal:

1) Monthly token volume: you mentioned the initial pilot would run ~5M tokens/month and the plan after Q3 ramp is 30–40M tokens/month. Can you confirm the conservative and optimistic figures?
2) Peak TPS / concurrency: you said peak traffic happens during billing cutovers and promotional emails — you estimated 40 TPS peak but we want to validate if 60 TPS spikes are possible.
3) Target unit economics: you gave a target of roughly $1,000–$1,500 per 1M tokens as your budget band for hosted inference. Is that target for inference-only (no embeddings) or combined?
4) SLA / latency SLO: do you have a 95th percentile latency target for interactive chat flows?

If you can reply with the two token scenarios (pilot / steady-state), peak TPS, and the target $/1M tokens we’ll produce a hosted quote and an estimate of monthly costs + expected monthly spend at both conservative and upside scenarios.

I’ve attached a simple template to fill in monthly volumes if easier.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: FinVelocity_Monthly_Token_Estimates.xlsx

From: Priya Shah <priya@finvelocity.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - quick follow-up + numbers

Hey Vanessa —

Thanks for the summary and the template. Quick answers below (filling in high level before we attach the sheet):

- Pilot (Q2): 5M tokens/month (mostly chat summarization + a few call transcription post-process prompts)
- Steady-state (Q4 goal): 35M tokens/month
- Peak TPS: typical peak ~40 TPS; we’ve seen short spikes up to ~70 TPS during promo-driven flows (10-20s bursts) — we can smooth those but would like pricing that accounts for occasional spikes.
- Target unit economics: our procurement team is looking for hosted pricing in the ballpark of $1,200 per 1M tokens (inference only). If embeddings are used later we’d expect separate line items.
- Latency SLO: customer-facing chat should be <300ms P95 if possible; internal async flows are more tolerant.

I’m attaching the filled template and our internal monthly forecast for next 12 months.

Best,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Product, FinVelocity
priya@finvelocity.com

Attachment: FinVelocity_Monthly_Token_Estimates.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@finvelocity.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, FinVelocity SalesOps <salesops@finvelocity.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - quick follow-up + numbers

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the quick answers and the attached forecast — that helps a lot. A few clarifying notes from our side before I build the hosted estimate:

- Spike handling: for short 10–20s bursts up to 70 TPS we typically recommend either burst capacity + autoscaling or a short-lived higher-tier routing policy. For pricing, we can model average sustained TPS and a 3x burst buffer (i.e., price for sustained 40 TPS, show incremental cost for burst to 70 TPS).
- Billing model: our hosted API billing is per-token for generation + per-embedding separately. For a rough hosted quote at your target $1,200/1M tokens, that implies $0.0012 per token. We’ll show both your target and our standard rate card so you can compare unit economics.
- Example monthly math (steady-state 35M tokens):
  - At target $1,200/1M => $42,000/mo
  - At our standard hosted list rate (see attached PDF) => $55,750/mo (this is illustrative; final rate can be adjusted based on commitment)

I’ll share a short proposal with: line-item monthly cost at conservative & upside volumes, an option for burst capacity (flat monthly + per-minute overage), and latency expectations tied to region + instance types. Alex — can you provide a quick note on expected latency at P95 for 40 TPS on our hosted EU/US pools?

Next steps: I’ll draft the proposal today and loop in Finance for any credits/commit assumptions. Can you confirm whether the procurement team wants a 12- or 24-month commitment for our discounted scenario?

Thanks —
Vanessa

Attachment: Redwood-Hosted-API-Ratecard.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@finvelocity.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - quick follow-up + numbers

Hi all —

Quick latency notes from the runtime/SE side:

- Hosted US pool (n1-standard GPU mix): for text-generation chat (avg prompt+response length ~1.2k tokens) we typically hit ~220ms P95 at sustained 40 TPS with appropriate batching turned on.
- For P95 <300ms at peaks up to 70 TPS we recommend:
  1) burst capacity reservation (adds a small fixed monthly cost) OR
  2) short-lived autoscale with warm workers (adds marginal per-minute cost during spikes).
- If you plan to move embeddings-heavy workloads later, embeddings latency is lower but has different cost profile (we'd price separately).

Happy to hop on a short call if you want the exact perf curves for your forecasted prompt lengths.

Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
